# `oaap app catalog-put`

hand the tested package of an instance to the package catalog, not released (RFC-0050 §9).

**Root:** needs `sudo`.

## Usage

```sh
oaap app catalog-put [--catalog CATALOG] [--wait WAIT]
                            [--tenant INSTANCE_TENANT]
                            name
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `name` | the instance whose retained package goes |
| `--catalog CATALOG` | the catalog (source id or instance), when the node reads from more than one |
| `--wait WAIT` | seconds to wait for the catalog's answer (default `30`) |
| `--tenant INSTANCE_TENANT` | tenant label: read the instance as a NAME inside this tenant (also: <tenant>/<name>) |
